0022600032.text: The Trail Blazers (5-1, 1st in the West and the Northwest) visit the Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific, 3rd in the West) on a two-game winning streak, and Portland has yet to lose on the road this season at 4-0. Portland leads this season's series 1-0 after a 136-129 win in Los Angeles on October 27, and the Trail Blazers also won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), who is also out, while Los Angeles will be missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation).
